raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "26.1.6"

recipe:
  name: mesalib
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://archive.mesa3d.org/mesa-${{ version }}.tar.xz
  sha256: 5296b88a0f1e012e2cb9ada150a2bbadf728ca81e5a4fb2ab43c83a4d2158606
  patches:
    - if: win
      then:
        - patches/0001-Add-inteljitevents-module.patch
        - patches/0002-nir-mark-assert-only-variable.patch

build:
  number: 0

outputs:
  - package:
      name: mesa-lavapipe
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      script: build_lavapipe
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - meson
        - pyyaml
        - mako
        - packaging
        - if: unix
          then:
            - flex
            - bison
        - if: win
          then: winflexbison
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - llvm
            - llvmdev
            - if: linux
              then: libdrm
        - glslang
      host:
        - if: unix
          then: expat
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - if: linux
          then: libdrm
        - spirv-tools
        - llvm
        - llvmdev
        - if: linux
          then:
            - libxcb
            - xorg-libx11
            - xorg-xorgproto
            - xorg-libxrandr
            - xorg-libxshmfence
        - if: win
          then:
            - libxml2-devel
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-lavapipe', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - requirements:
          run:
            - pkg-config
        script:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libvulkan_lvp${SHLIB_EXT}
              - if: x86_64
                then:
                  - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json
          - if: aarch64
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.aarch64.json
          - if: ppc64le
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.ppc64le.json
          - if: win
            then:
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\lib\vulkan_lvp.lib exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\vulkan_lvp.dll exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\vulkan\icd.d\lvp_icd.x86_64.json exit 1

  - package:
      name: mesa-kosmickrisp
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      skip:
        - not osx
      script: build_kosmickrisp
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - meson
        - pyyaml
        - mako
        - packaging
        - flex
        - bison
        - pkg-config
        - glslang
      host:
        - expat
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - spirv-tools
        - llvm
        - llvmdev
        - clangdev
        - libclc
        - llvm-spirv
        - libllvmspirv
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-kosmickrisp', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: x86_64
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/kosmickrisp_mesa_icd.x86_64.json
          - if: arm64
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/kosmickrisp_mesa_icd.aarch64.json

  - package:
      name: mesa-llvmpipe
      version: ${{ version }}
    build:
      skip:
        - osx
      script: build_llvmpipe
    requirements:
      build:
        - ${{ compiler('c') }}
        - ${{ stdlib('c') }}
        - ${{ compiler('cxx') }}
        - meson
        - pyyaml
        - mako
        - packaging
        - if: unix
          then:
            - flex
            - bison
        - if: win
          then: winflexbison
        - pkg-config
        - if: build_platform != host_platform
          then:
            - llvm
            - llvmdev
            - if: linux
              then: libdrm
        - glslang
      host:
        - if: unix
          then: expat
        - zlib
        - zstd
        - spirv-tools
        - if: linux
          then: libdrm
        - llvm
        - llvmdev
        - if: linux
          then:
            - libxcb
            - xorg-libx11
            - xorg-libxext
            - xorg-libxxf86vm
            - xorg-xorgproto
            - xorg-libxrandr
            - xorg-libxshmfence
            - libglvnd-devel
            - libegl-devel
            - libglx-devel
        - if: win
          then:
            - libxml2-devel
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-llvmpipe', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: linux
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/dri/swrast_dri${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgbm.so.1
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libGLX_mesa.so.0
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libEGL_mesa${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: win
            then:
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\opengl32.dll exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\libgallium_wgl.dll exit 1

  - package:
      name: mesalib
      version: ${{ version }}
    requirements:
      run:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-lavapipe', exact=True) }}
        - if: not osx
          then:
            - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-llvmpipe', exact=True) }}
          else:
            - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesa-kosmickrisp', exact=True) }}
      run_exports:
        - ${{ pin_subpackage('mesalib', upper_bound='x.x') }}
    tests:
      - script:
          - if: unix
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libvulkan_lvp${SHLIB_EXT}
              - if: x86_64
                then:
                  - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.x86_64.json
              - if: aarch64
                then:
                  - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.aarch64.json
              - if: ppc64le
                then:
                  - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/lvp_icd.ppc64le.json
          - if: linux
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libEGL_mesa${SHLIB_EXT}
              - test -f $PREFIX/lib/libgallium-*${SHLIB_EXT}
          - if: osx and x86_64
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/kosmickrisp_mesa_icd.x86_64.json
          - if: osx and arm64
            then:
              - test -f $PREFIX/share/vulkan/icd.d/kosmickrisp_mesa_icd.aarch64.json
          - if: win
            then:
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\vulkan_lvp.dll exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\share\vulkan\icd.d\lvp_icd.x86_64.json exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\opengl32.dll exit 1
              - if not exist %LIBRARY_PREFIX%\bin\libgallium_wgl.dll exit 1

about:
  homepage: https://www.mesa3d.org
  license: MIT
  license_family: MIT
  license_file: docs/license.rst
  summary: Mesa is an open-source implementation of the OpenGL specification - a system for rendering interactive 3D graphics.
  repository: https://gitlab.freedesktop.org/mesa/mesa
